assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Canonical-versus-consumer token drift analysis with stale-copy, unused-token, repeated-value reporting and a CI guard.
assessments.rationale: It supports constrained design scales and component styling, but it does not compare a supplied canonical token file with themes/components or produce the requested drift buckets and CI proposal.
assessments.source_anchor: Use a constrained spacing scale, not arbitrary values.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A source-of-truth token drift audit that identifies stale copies, raw values, unused and repeated tokens, plus a CI check.
assessments.rationale: This is a broad interface review and explicitly excludes system-level token governance, so it cannot deliver the token-specific audit.

It explicitly compares canonical tokens to downstream themes/styles, reports stale copies, hardcoded values, orphan tokens, and repeated untokenized values, keeps reconciliation approval-gated, and proposes a CI-failing check.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An audit of canonical design tokens versus web themes/components, including drift buckets and a CI guard.
assessments.rationale: It reviews a code diff for general quality, not a design-token source of truth or the requested repository-wide audit.
assessments.source_anchor: Review the change, not the whole codebase

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Read-only canonical token-versus-code drift reporting and a CI prevention check.
assessments.rationale: It pushes tokens into Figma and updates variables, rather than auditing a canonical token file against web themes/components; it supplies none of the requested drift buckets or CI check.
assessments.source_anchor: Push design tokens from code INTO Figma as variables

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Canonical token drift analysis of web theme/component styles with stale, raw, unused, and repeated-value reporting plus CI.
assessments.rationale: It routes design-generation workflows for prototypes and artifacts, not repository token drift auditing.
assessments.source_anchor: Route design-generation work into the right Open Design workflow mode

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Canonical token drift analysis of web theme/component styles with stale, raw, unused, and repeated-value reporting plus CI.
assessments.rationale: It performs gene set enrichment from ranked gene lists and offers no design-token or web-style audit.
assessments.source_anchor: Run GSEA on a ranked gene list

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Canonical token-versus-existing-theme/component drift analysis, a report-only approval gate, and CI drift prevention.
assessments.rationale: It exports Figma variables into token files; it does not inspect existing web themes/components for stale copies, hardcodes, unused/repeated values, or propose CI.
